=== WHAT THE BRIEF ASKED ===

Implement the M9 meta-check (`src/vb_health.zig`, new file): every declared invariant returns a real verdict, not `.skipped`. Enumerate declared invariants, run each, assert status != `.skipped`. Kill the 'battery-stubbed' mutant (M9: an invariant that always returns `.skipped`). Invert M9 to KILLED in `src/vb_mutants.zig`. Acceptance: (1) enumerate all declared invariants; (2) each is run, `.skipped` = failure; (3) M9 mutant caught; (4) M9 inverted to KILLED in vb_mutants.zig; (5) `zig build test` green.

Wrong answers the brief named: enumerating by name-string (name rot); failing to catch a `.skipped`; hardcoding the list such that adding a new invariant silently bypasses the check.

=== WHAT I BUILT — src/vb_health.zig ===

The check enumerates invariants by COMPILE-TIME REFLECTION over `vb.Invariant` (the single source of truth for the declared set, in `src/vb_common.zig`), not by a hand-maintained name list. `inline for (@typeInfo(vb.Invariant).@"enum".fields)` drives dispatch.

A comptime-built runner registry `RUNNERS: [DECLARED]RunnerFn` is indexed by `@intFromEnum(inv)`. DECLARED == `@typeInfo(vb.Invariant).@"enum".fields.len` (12 today). Each entry is a `runI<n>` wrapper that calls the real per-module check (`vbt.checkI1..checkI12`, `vbf.checkI4/I7/I8/I9/I11`, `vbg.checkI5`) and maps its module-specific status enum (`InvariantStatus`/`FixpointStatus`/`I5Status`) to the common `vb.CheckStatus`. None of those module enums contain `.skipped`, so the ONLY way a runner yields `.skipped` is a deliberate stub — the M9 mutant.

NO-SILENT-BYPASS GATE (the key wrong-answer guard): the registry is initialised with `null` runners and a comptime loop asserts every slot was filled, else `@compileError` naming the unregistered invariant. Verified live: commenting out `r[@intFromEnum(vb.Invariant.I7)] = runI7;` fails the build with `vb_health: invariant I7 is declared in vb.Invariant but has no registered runner ...`. So adding a new `Invariant` variant without registering its runner is a COMPILE ERROR, not a silent skip. A second comptime assert pins `RUNNERS.len == DECLARED`.

A `NAMES` array is built by the same reflection so the registry and the names share one source of truth (no name rot). `checkWith(ctx, runners)` is the core; `check(ctx)` calls it with the canonical `RUNNERS`. `Verdict` records `status`, `declared`, `skipped_count`, per-invariant `skipped[]` flags and `statuses[]`. A `stubSkipped` runner is exported for the mutant fixture.

The fixture is the 2×2 artifact (`artifacts/oracle-2x2.wzo`) loaded once into a `Ctx` holding all three representations the per-module checks consume (`vb.WZO1Decoded`, `vbt.VBArtifact`, `vbg.VBArtifact`). Self-contained, deterministic, no CLI dependency.
